notes: IMDog is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its no-argument constructor mints 1,000,000,000 IMDOG once to msg.sender, the factory during launch. It has no subsequent minting, transfer fees or administrative controls. The official, unmodified logo is ipfs://bafybeie5pg3kfdo6fl7dllampv44j2bymf46j554n5ehdmsryl5ejbrdre. The token permanently links this logo through LOGO_URI(), the image field in metadataJSON(), and the same metadata encoded by contractURI(). There are no application contracts or initialization calls. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
